independent_plausibility.evidence: Instrument has a coherent bench context, scale, service access, and independent use.

visible_function.evidence: Datum rail, battery door, and calibration target explain the major forms.

manufacturing_evidence.evidence: Fasteners, machined transitions, serial plate, and contact polish are visible.

material_realism.evidence: Aluminum has broad response; titanium has tight highlights; frosted optic transmits light.

human_specificity.evidence: Operator hand and skin retain pores, asymmetry, and believable contact.

cultural_context.evidence: Naming and workshop context are specific to the documented WRASAL production community, not ornament.

temporal_residue.evidence: Retired Rev B fixture and maintenance label establish previous version and use.

interface_physics.evidence: Steel-blue diagnostic indicator is mounted in the actual calibration optic and reports test state.

futuristic_not_cyberpunk.evidence: Advanced optical calibration is shown through a serviceable instrument, with no neon-noir styling.

human_scale.evidence: Operator hand, bench height, and instrument dimensions provide scale.

cross_system_continuity.evidence: Material, documentation, and maintenance logic can coexist with WRASAL environments.

operational_environment.evidence: Bench shows user, purpose, active test, retired fixture, and maintenance record.

memory_stack.evidence: Revision and wear encode time without a nostalgia filter.

blind_test.rationale: Without marks, labels, and accents, the physically used instrument, optical behavior, maintenance evidence, and low-key construction still read as WRASAL.

cultural_review.evidence: Context is carried by naming, operators, and use rather than generic symbolism.

technical_review.evidence: Every visible diagnostic and technical mark has an object anchor and operational purpose.
